name: DingTalk
summary: Post messages from Ogun workflows to a DingTalk group through a custom robot webhook. The access token inside the URL is the secret.

fields.name: webhook_url
fields.label: Webhook URL
fields.help: The robot's URL, including its access_token query parameter. It is a secret. Store it with ogun secrets set.

fields.name: signing_secret
fields.label: Signing secret
fields.help: Only when the robot's security setting is signature. Used to sign; never sent.

operators.summary: Post a text or Markdown message to the DingTalk group the custom robot belongs to.

notes: The robot's access token is part of the webhook URL, so the whole URL is stored as a secret and its query string never reaches logs, events or lineage. A custom robot must have a security setting: keyword, IP allowlist or signature. If it uses a keyword, the message must contain it.

implementation.evidence: Sink in ogun-export, written from public documentation and checked against a local fake in unit tests; not run against the real service.
